geometry_capability.polygon: exact four-corner axis-aligned rectangle plus repeated closing vertex; any rotation/reversal permitted
geometry_capability.comparator: multiset(element,layer,datatype,exact_integer_bbox) and top identity; source-record backlinks retained; no byte equality requirement

unit_scale_contract.encoding: GDS base16 REAL8 round-nearest ties-to-even 56-bit mantissa
unit_scale_contract.equivalence: Both UNITS fields bind independently to the sole nominal candidate with exact normal exponent and absolute error <= REAL8_ULP/2. KLayout-generated expected GDS has UNITS-only nearest56 normalization with explicit provenance; XY never changed.
unit_scale_contract.output_nominal_selection: source nominal tick is fixed at 1 nm; output policy may select any positive rational nominal tick exactly encodable to nearest56 units, but every source-coordinate/output-tick ratio must be an integer in signed 32-bit range; source and output scale bindings are separate

nominal_source.basis: 1 nm accommodates all integer source coordinates; inherited W003 toy choice, not inferred by GCD; no PDK/PCell/production default

cdl_dialect.case_policy: case_sensitive identifiers, directives and parameter names
cdl_dialect.literal_grammar: positive integer for NFIN,NF,M; positive integer followed by n for L,W; VT token toy
cdl_dialect.semantic_comparator: cell, ordered pins, globals, device identities, models, ordered terminals and every parameter axis equal; line/parameter order, full-line comments and whitespace irrelevant
